content:
Hi Kuz99

You can already select multiple messages and move them to a folder.

With the applicable account selected (not unified inbox)

  1. Long press (or swipe) each email to select it.
  2. Tap the three dot menu.
  3. Tap move.
  4. Select folder.

If you don't see move listed in the three dot menu. Navigate to settings > general settings > display > visible message actions Tick Move, then ok.

content:
Hi Kuz

The app doesn't have a favourite folders feature.

You can set folders to appear in the upper section of the destination folder list.

  1. Open the account side bar with your account folders listed
  2. Tap manage folders (botton of the list)
  3. Tap a folder name
  4. Tap "Show in top group"

The folder will then appear higher up the list when selecting a destination folder.

You can make your favourite folders suggestion on Mozilla connect where community members can vote for the idea.

https://connect.mozilla.org/t5/ideas/idb-p/ideas/label-name/thunderbird%20android
